alsoTry.name: Bettei Sushi Masashi
alsoTry.note: The chef's second counter nearby in Kita-Aoyama (opened 25 April 2026): Bettei omakase ¥27,500, or the main restaurant's ¥39,600 omakase made by its own chefs; including tax; smart casual

bookingOpens: Bookings only. Online through OMAKASE (linked from the restaurant's website) or by phone. Overseas visitors can also request a seat through TableAll, which adds its own ¥8,000 booking fee.
groups: A private room for up to four guests, besides the 10-seat counter.
